description.title: Give an unforgettable experience
description.paragraph: The Gift Card lets you give a traditional balloon flight without choosing the date immediately. The voucher is transferable, becomes active one month after purchase, and can be used during the following six months, subject to availability.

steps.title: Purchase the gift card
steps.description: Buy the individual voucher and keep the purchase reference number.

steps.title: Receive your voucher
steps.description: Give the card as a gift or keep it to use at a later date.

steps.title: Activate your flight date
steps.description: Contact Flying Pictures with your reference number and reserve at least 48 hours in advance, subject to availability.

steps.title: Enjoy the traditional flight
steps.description: Experience the balloon flight with a toast, flight certificate, and breakfast included under the voucher conditions.
